2610.01634.title: Yo-ByT5: Efficient and High-Fidelity Diacritic Restoration for Yorùbá
2610.01634.paper_summary: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.
2610.01634.paper_summary_zh: Yorùbá 是一種廣泛使用的音調語言，依賴於變音符號以避免詞彙歧義。<lb/>然而，它經常在沒有這些變音符號的情況下書寫，從而妨礙了下游的自然語言處理 (NLP) 任務。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了 Yo-ByT5，一個從 ByT5-small 微調而來的字節級自動變音符號恢復 (ADR) 模型。<lb/>我們在 YAD 基準上，根據一致的協議，將 Yo-ByT5 與五個公開發布的 Yorùbá ADR 模型和一個開放權重的大型語言模型 (LLM) 進行評估。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，Yo-ByT5 的性能與現有最強模型 mT5-base 相當，具有 10.14% 的 DER 和 3.48% 的 CER。<lb/>此外，儘管使用的參數數量約為 mT5-base 的一半，但它在文本保真度上表現出色。<lb/>我們還發布了我們的訓練代碼和模型輸出，並呼籲開發一個更大、專門針對 Yorùbá 變音符號恢復的基準。
